summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on identifying and managing data gaps from specific hardware, such as routers that fail to transmit data (e.g., JJ or lidar-equipped routers). [p1] inquired about an existing flag to filter out alerts for these non-reporting devices.

[me] confirmed the existence of a relevant flag within the `stat_ping` table and also noted its availability on the new schema. Although initially discussing general flags, [me] clarified that the intended mechanism relates specifically to ping data.

Later, [p1] expressed concern about integrating this filtering logic into the inventory view used for monitoring purposes.
decisions: A flag related to device reporting status (ping) exists and can be utilized.
action_items: [me] will implement the necessary changes today to incorporate the non-reporting router filter into the relevant inventory view.
